_about: Photo views for street.html. Image coordinates are pixels of the 1200 x 1600 photos. Calibration: horizon_y and vanishing_x are where the street's parallel lines (kerbs, building base, lane markings) meet; street_bearing_deg is the street direction from OSM (way 81083900), towards the vanishing point. ground: polygon where objects can be placed. foreground: photo parts in front of anything placed (posts, parked cars). centre_views: AI images of the street from the centre of the road, made from the listed photos by scripts/centre_view.py.
